# Motion

`motion.js` is the unmodified browser bundle of Motion **12.23.24**, served locally so homepage animations do not depend on a runtime CDN request.

- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/motion@12.23.24/dist/motion.js
- Documentation: https://motion.dev/docs/quick-start
- License: MIT; see `MOTION-LICENSE.md`.

Homepage animation behavior lives in `../../experience.js`. The page stays readable if the library fails to load. OS reduced-motion preferences and the homepage pause control disable decorative animation.
